title: AMMA: A Multi-Chiplet Memory-Centric Architecture for Low-Latency 1M Context Attention Serving
abstract: arXiv:2604.26103v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: All current LLM serving systems place the GPU at the center, from production-level attention-FFN disaggregation to NVIDIA's Rubin GPU-LPU heterogeneous platform. Even academic PIM/PNM proposals still treat the GPU as the central hub for cross-device communication. Yet the GPU's compute-rich architecture is fundamentally mismatched with the memory-bound nature of decode-phase attention, inflating serving latency while wasting power and die area on idle compute units. The problem is compounded as reasoning and agentic workloads push context lengths toward one million tokens, making attention latency the primary user-facing bottleneck.   To address these inefficiencies, we present AMMA, a multi-chiplet, memory-centric architecture for low-latency long-context attention. translated_title: AMMA：面向低延迟百万级上下文注意力服务的多芯粒以内存为中心架构
translated_abstract: 当前所有的大语言模型（LLM）服务系统都以GPU为中心，从生产级的注意力-FFN分离架构到NVIDIA的Rubin GPU-LPU异构平台皆是如此。即使是学术界的PIM/PNM（存内处理/近存处理）提案，也仍然将GPU视为跨设备通信的中心枢纽。然而，GPU以计算见长的架构与解码阶段注意力任务的访存受限本质根本不匹配，这不仅抬高了服务延迟，还在闲置的计算单元上浪费了功耗和芯片面积。随着推理和智能体工作负载将上下文长度推向一百万token，这一问题进一步恶化，使注意力延迟成为用户可感知的主要瓶颈。为解决这些低效问题，我们提出了AMMA，一种面向低延迟长上下文注意力的多芯粒、以内存为中心的架构。AMMA用HBM-PNM（高带宽内存存内处理）立方体取代GPU计算裸片，将可用内存带宽大致提升一倍，从而更好地服务于访存受限的注意力工作负载。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出AMMA——一种以内存为中心的多芯粒架构，通过用HBM-PNM立方体取代GPU计算裸片将内存带宽约提升一倍，从而实现低延迟的百万token长上下文注意力服务。
en_tdlr: AMMA is a multi-chiplet, memory-centric architecture that replaces GPU compute dies with HBM-PNM cubes to roughly double available memory bandwidth, enabling low-latency serving of 1M-token context attention.
